name: adf.test
title: Augmented Dickey-Fuller statistic and the tabulated p-value. The lag is trunc((n-1)^(1/3)).

origin.description: Augmented Dickey-Fuller statistic and the tabulated p-value. The lag is trunc((n-1)^(1/3)).

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Augmented Dickey-Fuller statistic and the tabulated p-value. The lag is trunc((n-1)^(1/3)).
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
set.seed(11)
x <- rnorm(50)
a <- adf.test(x)
paste(cell(a$statistic), cell(a$p.value), a$parameter, sep = "|")
